rules.statement: A mortgage bond executed by a wife without the written consent of her husband is invalid for non-compliance with section 9 of Ordinance No. 15 of 1876, but may be ratified by the husband to support a claim for money lent on the bond.
rules.supporting_quote: "The first of these points depends upon the correct interpretation of section 9 of Ordinance No. 15 of 1876. That section after giving a wife a separate estate in her immovable property proceeds as follows: - 'Such woman shall .... have as full power of disposing of and dealing with such property by any lawful act inter vivos with the written consent of her husband, but not otherwise, or by last will without such consent as if she were unmarried.'"
